plan: Given my value of $10, I should bid slightly below it to ensure a positive expected profit if I win. Bidding exactly my value risks breaking even or losing if I win. The optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while considering the risk of losing. Since this is a one-off round, I will bid $9.9 to maximize my chance of winning without overpaying.

Given my value of $30, I aim to maximize profit by bidding slightly below my value to outbid others while ensuring a profit margin. Rational bidders will bid close to their values. To avoid overbidding, I’ll bid $29.9. This maximizes the chance of winning while keeping a profit if the second-highest bid is near my value.
